chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When a man performs the 'Umrah of enjoyment, he has fulfilled what is incumbent upon him from the obligation of 'Umrah."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fulfilling the obligation of Umrah when performing Umrah al-Tamattu?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi cites this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the legal sufficiency of the 'Umrah performed during the 'Umrah of Tamattu', confirming it discharges the obligatory duty without need for repetition. This ruling is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing the single 'Umrah obligation within the combined pilgrimage structure from the separate Hajj rites, ensuring pilgrims understand the completeness of their ritual performance.
